text: Every line on this chart is wind.
zh: 这张海图上的每一条线，都是风。

text: Then, over the Philippines, they began to turn.
zh: 后来，在菲律宾上空，它们开始打转。
一只平静的风眼，睁开了。

text: Its name was Yagi. Each point is one record of its path.
zh: 它叫“摩羯”。每个点，是它路径上的一条记录。

text: Sixty-two metres per second. The top grade: super typhoon.
sub: 62 metres per second. The top grade: super typhoon.
zh: 每秒62米。最高一级：超强台风。
asr: 62 meters per second. The top grade, super typhoon.

text: It came ashore at Wenchang, and the land bent the lines.
zh: 它在文昌登陆，陆地把风线拧弯了。
asr: It came ashore at Wenqiang and the land bent the lines.

text: It crossed the strait, and struck the mainland again.
zh: 它穿过海峡，再一次登上陆地。

text: Into Vietnam, the spiral came apart, and the lines went back to ink.
zh: 进入越南，螺旋散开，风线又变回墨色。

text: Its whole week fits in one last line.
zh: 它的整整一周，装进了最后这一条线。
